faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this chapter, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Base salary
means that regular monthly or annual pay received by an employee, inclusive of overtime,
               for services performed, but which would include the proportionate amount of longevity
               for that month or year, but shall not include commissions, reimbursement of expenses
               or bonuses. No other benefits shall be included in the computation of base salary.
Beneficiary
means any person, other than a retirant, in receipt of a pension payable from funds
               provided by the retirement system.
Board
means the board of trustees provided for in this chapter.
Compensation
means the salary paid by the city to a member for service rendered by him to the
               city as a police officer.
Credited compensation
means the total amount of compensation paid to a member annually by the city for
               all personal services performed while the member is a police officer, including overtime
               pay, longevity pay, and contributions made by the city pursuant to sections 125, 414(h),
               or 457 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. Commissions, reimbursement
               of expenses, and bonuses are not included in credited compensation. No other benefits
               are included in credited compensation.
Credited service
means service credited to a member to the extent provided under this chapter.
Disability pay
means that compensation paid to a member on disability status in equal monthly installments
               from funds of the retirement system.
Disability status
means the inability of a member to perform the duties of his regular occupation,
               taking into consideration the member's training, education and experience. Such status
               may be temporary or permanent according to the determination of the board.
In the performance of duty or by reason of service
means all service performed as a police officer for the city, whether on duty or
               off duty and shall specifically include services rendered in connection with the special
               off-duty police assignments.
Member
means any person included in the membership of the retirement system and shall include
               all police officers as defined in this section.
Pension
means an amount payable, in equal monthly installments, from funds of the retirement
               system to a retirant.
Police officer
means an employee of the police department holding the rank of patrol person, including
               probationary patrol persons, or higher rank. The term "police officer" shall not include:
(1)
Private employed police officers;
(2)
Persons temporarily employed as police officers during emergencies; and
(3)
Civilian employees of the police department.
Retirant
means a member who retires with a pension payable under the provisions of this chapter.
Retirement
means withdrawal from the service with a pension payable from funds of the retirement
               system.
Retirement system
means the city police officers' retirement system created and established under the
               provisions of this chapter.
(Code 1960, § 19-1; Code 1981, § 26-1; Ord. No. 2610, § 1, 4-17-1989)
